profile.headline: Mobile Application Developer
profile.summary:
Professional Software Engineer focused on building world class mobile applications. 

Skilled working in the Java ecosystem:  Native Android development in Java and Kotlin, the Gradle build system, etc. 

Native iOS development with Swift.

Writing RESTful APIs with Nodejs, .NET Core, Spring MVC

App store release management for both iOS and Android platforms. 

Automating build/release and app store publishing tasks using tools like fastlane inside CI/CD pipelines.

Primary interests are in mobile development and currently specializes in full stack mobile solutions with an emphasis on front end development.

Also has experience as a software development team lead and managing all aspects of the agile development process.
